ops.title: P1-B2 (move cc-pool's FP content bridge onto the shared holder + OpListDomains) is BLOCKED on v0.38.3 — the shared cask holder wires NO DomainSource and isn't signed with cc-pool's app-group entitlement; needs fusekit-first wiring. Deferred by user (2026
ops.body:
Discovered 2026-07-10 in the P1-B2 recon (opus halted before any edit, verified vs the fusekit v0.38.3 module source).

**Two independent blockers make the FP-bridge-on-holder cutover impossible on v0.38.3:**
1. **No DomainSource on the shared holder.** `cmd/holder/main.go` builds `mountd.Server` WITHOUT a `DomainSource`, so `holderClient().ListDomains()` always errors "this holder has no File Provider domain source". There is no fusekit op for a consumer to register its FP app (AppPath/ControlSocket) so the holder could build a `RemoteDomainHost` DomainSource. Rewiring cc-pool's orphan detection to ListDomains would BREAK the currently-working `~/Library/CloudStorage` scrape.
2. **The shared holder cask lacks cc-pool's app-group entitlement.** The sandboxed FP extension can only dial `~/Library/Group Containers/SXKCTF23Q2.ccp/b.sock` when the binder holds the `SXKCTF23Q2.ccp` app-group entitlement. The daemon binds it today BECAUSE it carries that entitlement; the `com.yasyf.fusekit-holder` cask (release.yml Developer-ID signing) does NOT. Moving the bind to the holder → permanently bind-failed = DEAD FP data plane.

Also: `DomainInfo{Domain,DisplayName}` carries NO owner/app discriminator and `acct-NN` isn't tenant-unique (cc-notes could use it too), so a name-only own-domain filter CANNOT be proven cross-tenant-safe — a too-broad match could reap a foreign tenant's FP domain. Cross-tenant-safe reaping REQUIRES fusekit to return an owner/app-scoped domain list.

Recon corrections: `MinBridgeHolderVersion` does NOT exist in fusekit v0.38.3 (a version pre-flight must be a new cc-pool-side const; cc-pool already has `MinHolderVersion`/`HolderVersionMitigated()`). The Track-C bridge CLIENT methods (AddBridge/RemoveBridge/Bridges/ListDomains, content.RelaySource, BridgeInfo.State) DID ship (fusekit v0.37.0) — but the shared-holder-side CONFIGURATION (DomainSource + entitlement) did not. Capability shipped ahead of the consumer, as usual.

**Decision (user, 2026-07-10):** DEFER B2. cc-pool v0.51.0 ships with P1-A + reqs1+2 + B1b (the Option-B cooperation) only; FP setup stays daemon-bound (works, unregressed). User asked to RE-ENTER PLAN MODE for the remaining work including B2. The re-plan must decide the fusekit-first wiring: (a) a consumer-FP-app registration op returning owner-scoped domains, (b) an app-group scheme for the holder cask (a shared group, or re-sign) — AND question whether coupling the shared multi-tenant holder to a consumer's app group is even right vs keeping the FP bridge daemon-bound permanently. Rejected: a cc-pool-OWNED re-signed holder (contradicts one-shared-holder + the never-stop-the-shared-holder invariant). See [[claude-pool-project]], [[cc-pool-fileprovider-signing-reality]], [[trackc-fp-bridge-v037]].
